name: edumatch
description: EduMatch — plataforma de tutorías académicas (web + app Android con Capacitor)

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:db
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/gradle.js assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/gradle.js assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/gradle.js bundleRelease
